description: Free-text search over MyOutfitters' Canadian hunting and fishing outfitters (pourvoiries). Returns up to 10 documents with id, title and URL; pass an id to `fetch` for the full profile. For precise multi-criteria filtering (species, region, budget, lodging, dates) prefer search_outfitters. No phone, e-mail or website is ever returned.

query.description: Natural-language query, e.g. 'white pike fishing in Lanaudière' or 'pourvoirie chasse orignal Abitibi'.

name: search
title: Search MyOutfitters
